chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan mother in her forties wearing a mustard-yellow headscarf and a faded olive-green djellaba with rolled-up sleeves, plastic sandals.
chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan father in his fifties with a thin black mustache, wearing a brown wool djellaba and a white knitted skullcap.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Doorway of a poor small concrete house in a dusty Moroccan village near the Atlantic coast, late afternoon. MOM walks in holding a completely EMPTY dry woven basket, clothes clean and dry. DAD stands facing her with arms crossed, eyes narrowed in suspicion, an awkward tense standoff between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Rocky Atlantic beach near El Jadida, Morocco, low tide. MOM bends over wet rocks pulling dark red seaweed and stuffing it into a woven basket, sleeves wet, tired but determined.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Flat rooftop of a poor village house in Morocco under strong sun. MOM spreads piles of dark red seaweed on the rooftop to dry, wiping sweat from her forehead.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan village living room with a cheap sofa and a small TV. DAD lounges on the sofa sipping tea, indifferent, waving his hand dismissively, while MOM in the background heads out the door carrying an empty basket.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Front door of a poor village house in Morocco, early morning. MOM, basket on her arm, points toward the sea in the distance, explaining with a forced smile, while DAD listens from the doorway, half convinced.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Evening in the yard of a poor Moroccan village house. MOM comes home with clean dry clothes, neat headscarf and a totally empty dry basket. DAD stares at the empty basket with raised eyebrows, surprised.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night inside a small Moroccan village kitchen lit by one bulb. DAD stands in the foreground, leaning, staring sideways with a deeply suspicious frowning look. MOM in the background washes dishes, glancing back nervously.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan village living room at night. MOM explains nervously with both hands raised, pointing toward a neighbouring village, while DAD sits on a cushion with arms crossed, one eyebrow raised, not believing her.
